name: unischolar-figure
description: UniScholar Figure: evidence-backed Figure 1 workflow design with FigEdit editable PowerPoint export.

interface.shortDescription: Research, design, draw, and export editable Figure 1 workflows.
interface.longDescription: Builds an evidence-backed Figure 1 content map, derives an original journal-appropriate visual system from a cited reference, draws the workflow, and uses a bundled FigEdit snapshot to produce editable SVG and PowerPoint outputs with explicit quality gates.
defaultPrompt: Research my topic and build an editable Figure 1 workflow.
Turn my manuscript into a journal-style Figure 1 PPTX.
Audit this Figure 1 and rebuild it with FigEdit.
